Part.name: Relikt panel (hull)
Part.description: Relikt - modular hull panel (game proxy) Resize X/Z to add whole cells (1x1 up to 8x8): 270 x 150 mm per cell, 136 mm deep. Each cell has its own formed front plate, bolts on every second cell corner and a finite reactive charge. Plates: 1 | one 13 mm active plate per cell, inclined 25 degrees APFSDS at 60°: 19.2% less pen. (L/D 30) HEAT at 60°: 54.6% less pen. Tandem: no guaranteed protection Used on: T-90M, T-80BVM hull glacis (family) Mount: incoming fire toward local +X (lengthwise) Mass and cost scale with paid cell area only, never depth
